newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Plywood maker Zongyi gets A share offer approval.
newsitem.headline: Plywood maker Zongyi gets A share offer approval.

text.p: Plywood maker Jiangsu Zongyi Co Ltd has received the approval of the China Securities Regulatory Commission to go ahead with an offer of 22 million A shares and list the stock in Shanghai, a company spokesman said on Friday.

The price and timing of the issue have not yet been set, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin, adding that Shanghai Shenyin & Wanguo Securities had been appointed the chief underwriter for the offer.
Zongyi, based in the city of Nantong in eastern Jiangsu province, aims to use the proceeds to expand its main operations and diversify into tea leaf processing, the official said.
He said Zongyi had projected net profits of 34.02 million yuan for 1996, compared with 19.91 million yuan last year and 18.24 million yuan in 1994.
Zongyi plans to fuel the profits growth with its ongoing moves to step up the scale of core business, the official said.
After the A share offer, Zongyi would have total share capital of 60 million shares, comprised of 36.10 million state shares, 22 million A shares and 1.90 million employee shares.
